theory.intro: Millimetres, centimetres, metres and kilometres are metric units of length. A smaller unit means more units are needed to measure the same length.
facts: $1\text{ km}=1000\text{ m}$, $1\text{ m}=100\text{ cm}$ and $1\text{ cm}=10\text{ mm}$.
To change to a smaller unit, multiply; to a larger unit, divide. Use the number of smaller units in one larger unit.
Use the same unit before adding or subtracting lengths.
steps: Write the relationship between the units.
Multiply to change to a smaller unit; divide to change to a larger unit. Use more than one conversion if needed.
Write the answer with the requested unit. Before adding or subtracting lengths, change them to the same unit.

workedExamples.question_text:
Convert these lengths.
a. $6.83$ cm to millimetres
b. $927$ cm to metres
c. $0.048$ km to metres
workedExamples.solution_text:
a. Millimetres are smaller than centimetres, so multiply by $10$.
$6.83\times10=68.3$
$6.83\text{ cm}=68.3\text{ mm}$
b. Metres are larger than centimetres, so divide by $100$.
$927\div100=9.27$
$927\text{ cm}=9.27\text{ m}$
c. Metres are smaller than kilometres, so multiply by $1000$.
$0.048\times1000=48$
$0.048\text{ km}=48\text{ m}$

Change kilometres to metres, then centimetres and millimetres.
$0.037\times1000=37$
$0.037\text{ km}=37\text{ m}$
$37\times100=3700$
$37\text{ m}=3700\text{ cm}$
$3700\times10=37000$
$3700\text{ cm}=37000\text{ mm}$
So $0.037\text{ km}=37000\text{ mm}$.

workedExamples.question_text:
A piece of wood is $3.7$ m long. A length of $86$ cm is removed from one end.
How long is the piece of wood now? Give your answer in centimetres.
workedExamples.solution_text:
Change metres to centimetres first.
$3.7\times100=370$
$3.7\text{ m}=370\text{ cm}$
$370-86=284$
The remaining length is $284\text{ cm}$.

mastery.question_text: A student converts $2.7$ km to $0.0027$ m. Explain the error and give the correct conversion.
mastery.solution_text:
Metres are smaller than kilometres, so the numerical value must increase.
$2.7\text{ km}=2.7\times1000\text{ m}$
$=2700\text{ m}$
